verdicts.title: Numerical Algebraic Geometry for Macaulay2
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Numerical Algebraic Geometry uses numerical data to describe algebraic varieties. It is based on the methods of numerical polynomial homotopy continuation, an alternative to the classical symbolic approaches of computational algebraic geometry. We present a package, the driving idea behind which is to interlink the existing symbolic methods of Macaulay2 and the powerful engine of numerical approximate computations. verdicts.title: Convex Algebraic Geometry of Curvature Operators
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the structure of the set of algebraic curvature operators satisfying a sectional curvature bound under the light of the emerging field of Convex Algebraic Geometry. More precisely, we determine in which dimensions $n$ this convex semialgebraic set is a spectrahedron or a spectrahedral shadow; in particular, for $n\geq5$, these give new counter-examples to the Helton--Nie Conjecture.
